title: Three Celebrity vegan mac and cheese recipes tested and judged

locations.name: Probable: Rachel's parents' home kitchen
locations.basis: Transcript confirms host is visiting her parents and that the parents act as judges; no explicit filming location is stated.

summary: Goodful host Rachel tests three celebrity vegan mac and cheese recipes from Michael Simon, Tabitha Brown, and Minimalist Baker. Each recipe’s prep and finishing steps are demonstrated, including a cauliflower-based vegan sauce with a cashew nutritional‑yeast topping (Michael Simon), a butternut squash and potato-cheese sauce (Tabitha Brown) with dairy-free cheese and yogurt, and a caramelized-onion and eggplant-based sauce (Minimalist Baker) finished with a toasted onion topping. The host’s parents sample and rank the dishes, with Tabitha Brown declared the winner. The video emphasizes plant-based substitutions, kitchen techniques for creamy vegan sauces, and baking or broiling for texture and color.

sections.title: Intro and format
concepts: format of judging by Rachel and her parents
sections.description: Rachel introduces the experiment: testing three vegan mac and cheese recipes from Michael Simon, Tabitha Brown, and Minimalist Baker, with her parents serving as judges.

sections.title: Michael Simon: Cauliflower mac and cheese with vegan parmesan topping
sections.description: Michael Simon’s recipe begins with sautéing cauliflower and onions in olive oil, adding garlic and vegetable broth, simmering until soft, and blending into a smooth sauce. Pasta is folded in, then a vegan parmesan topping made from cashews, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, bread crumbs, and parsley is prepared and baked at high heat for a golden top.

sections.title: Tabitha Brown: Butternut squash and potato vegan mac and cheese
sections.description: Tabitha Brown’s approach uses a squash-potato base cooked with garlic herb seasoning and vegan butter, enriched with nutritional yeast, non-dairy yogurt, and Daiya vegan cheese. Vegetable broth thins the sauce before mixing with pasta, and the finished dish is topped with smoked paprika for color.

sections.title: Minimalist Baker: Caramelized onion mac and cheese with eggplant sauce
sections.description: Minimalist Baker sliders in a caramelized onion base with broiled eggplant blended into a creamy sauce using almond milk, cornstarch, and nutritional yeast. The onions are caramelized, the eggplant is broiled and peeled, then the sauce is mixed with pasta and half the onions, with the remaining onions used as a topping.

sections.title: Judging and winner reveal
sections.description: Rachel and her parents taste each macaroni dish and rank them. Tabitha Brown’s version is declared the winner by the judges.

sections.title: Closing: judge introductions and credits
sections.description: The parents introduce themselves (Carla and Peter) and the video closes with brief credits/music.
